title: Transporting a contract through a state embedding
statement: Let $C$ be a contract for a machine $M$ with entry state $e$ and exit set $X$, let $N$ be another machine, and let $f$ be an injective map from the states of $M$ to those of $N$. Suppose that, at every state satisfying a predicate $G$, the transition of $N$ at its image under $f$ is the state-renamed transition of $M$; also suppose that every state visited by $M$ at a time strictly before $C$’s endpoint satisfies $G$, for every eligible start. Then there is a contract for $N$ with entry state $f(e)$ and exit set consisting of the images under $f$ of the states in $X$: its start configurations are decoded by replacing their optional state with $e$, and its endpoint states are mapped by $f$, while its running times and work-head bounds are inherited from $C$.
